products.title: Poppy Seeds
products.description: Oriental poppy seeds for stunning red and orange blooms. Thrives in Kashmir's climate.

seasons.planting: Oct-Nov (best) or Feb in very cold pockets after frost

growing_instructions: Broadcast seeds on fine, well-drained soil and press gently without deep covering.
Choose full sun and avoid transplanting due to taproot sensitivity.
Thin seedlings to 20-25 cm spacing after establishment.
care_instructions: Water lightly until germination, then only when surface dries.
Avoid heavy nitrogen, which reduces flowering quality.
Stake taller strains in windy sites.
Collect dry seed pods when they turn straw-colored.

products.title: Sunflower Seeds
products.description: Bright sunflower seeds for tall, cheerful blooms. Attracts pollinators and birds.

growing_instructions: Direct sow in full sun at 2-3 cm depth in well-drained loamy soil.
Space 30-45 cm apart and stake giant cultivars if winds are strong.
Use phosphorus- and potash-rich basal nutrition for better head formation.
care_instructions: Water deeply every 5-7 days; do not keep soil constantly soggy.
Weed early to reduce competition during rapid stem elongation.
Protect heads from birds as seeds mature.
Harvest when back of flower head turns yellow-brown and seeds harden.
